# netbox_circuit_provider_account (Resource)

An account a NetBox circuit provider holds (circuits.provideraccount).

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/circuits/provideraccount/):

> This model can be used to represent individual accounts associated with a provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_circuit_provider" "test" {
  name = "test-circuit-provider"
}

resource "netbox_circuit_provider_account" "test" {
  account             = "test-account"
  name                = "test-circuit-provider-account"
  circuit_provider_id = netbox_circuit_provider.test.id
  description         = "test-description"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) Account number with the provider.
- `circuit_provider_id` (Number) Id of the provider the account is held with.

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the account.
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netbox_circuit_provider_account.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netbox_circuit_provider_account.test 123
```
